title: How to Edit / Update Subscriptions for Members with Recurring Subscriptions | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Edit / Update Subscriptions for Members with Recurring Subscriptions Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000069505 Currently, subscriptions must be edited individually — including changes to the next billing date, amount, or billing cycle. Bulk updates for subscriptions are not currently available. To modify an existing subscription, follow the steps below: 1. Go to Members » Search Members 2. Find the member 3. Click on Actions » Payment History 4. Click the "Subscriptions" tab: 5. Then find the subscription that needs to be modified and click Actions » 6. In this section, 4 fields can be modified: Payment Amount Billing Cycle Next Payment Due Date Deletion of past-due/upcoming invoices Internal Subscription Notes can also be added at the bottom of the page: 7. After making the changes, click "Continue & Save Changes" 8. The changes will be reflected here: Additional Subscription Information Create a new order (subscription): How To Manually Bill A Member / Create A Subscription For A Member Cancel orders: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders Refund a member: How Refunds Work Subscription Expiration Date Recurring subscriptions do not have an expiration date. A recurring subscription ends when the paid membership plan is cancelled by the member or the admin.
